title: Bulk Email Wizard Permission Consistency

items.action: preview bulk email recipients and rendered mail
immediately start the created bulk email operation
execute the bulk email send handler

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: Existing preview, operation create/execute, and fair email execute permissions are reused.

backend.reason: Existing PreviewBulkEmailOperationUseCase, CreateOperationUseCase, StartOperationUseCase, and SendBulkEmailOperationUseCase authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

audit.reason: Existing bulk email operation and send audit behavior is unchanged.

route_guard.reason: Preview and send are independently protected at their action boundaries.

notes: Bulk email preview now requires fair_crm.fair_emails.preview before the preview request and before summary navigation. Sending requires fair_crm.operations.create, fair_crm.operations.execute, and fair_crm.fair_emails.execute at both the send callback and final send affordance.
